headline: US Dollar Index Climbs Near 20-Month High as AI Rally Sparks Rate Hike Bets
summary: The US dollar hovered near a 20-month high as a renewed AI-led market recovery stoked expectations that economic resilience could allow the Federal Reserve to maintain higher interest rates.
why: The US Dollar Index measures the greenback against a basket of major global reserve currencies.

impacts.name: US Dollar Index
impacts.why: Expectations of prolonged higher Fed rates boosted capital demand for the US dollar.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Risen expectations for sticky US interest rates supported broad dollar appreciation against global currencies.
